system.description:
The wall-knight who holds what others attack: the Boldock Wall-Knights facing the Red Waste from the Wall and Westfront Fort, and the keepers of every border hold.

  • Hold the Wall (1st): while an ally is within 5ft of you, you and that ally have Advantage on checks to resist being shoved, tripped or grappled.
  • Siege Discipline (1st): Advantage on checks involving fortification, siege assessment or coordinating a defence.
  • Wall-Forged Dread (5th): you gain Demoralise at 5th level rather than 7th, and it is harsher: on a failed Will save, enemies stay Frightened of you while the Command lasts, not just until the end of their next turn.
  • Shield of the Wall (10th): an ally within 30ft of you who has not moved since the start of its last turn imposes Disadvantage on the first attack against it each round.
